source_policy: Authored guides and new challenges derived from current learning-bridge pack concepts. Suggested source IDs are conceptual themes only, NOT verified exam-question mappings or admissions.
browser_storage: localStorage; unverified and clearable; no secure first-attempt witness or automatic grading
answer_delivery: Public static JSON fetched only on learner request after local first-attempt lock; URL is accessible without authentication, not secure exam storage

journeys.title: Multi-force work–energy ledger
journeys.guided_example: 2 kg box moving horizontally, +30 J pull, -12 J friction, net +18 J, final K=19 J, speed=sqrt(19) m/s
journeys.independent_challenge: 3 kg scooter uphill 2 m / rise 0.5 m, motor 15 N, friction 3 N; decide four signed force-work entries, net kinetic energy and final speed

journeys.title: Spring contact and phase changes
journeys.guided_example: 1 kg cart touching an unattached spring compressed 0.20 m with k=100 N/m, smooth after release; K at natural length=2 J, speed 2 m/s
journeys.independent_challenge: 2 kg cart, k=200 N/m and compression 0.10 m smooth during contact, then rough 0.50 m strip with 1 N friction; change energy model at contact boundary
